purpose: Service content gaps observed on primary competitor pages. Patterns inform original Tiling.ca copy; no ranking causation is claimed.

findings.observedPattern: Dedicated bathroom scope, an explicit work sequence, relevant service-area links and project imagery make the service easier to assess.
findings.limitation: Public content review only; no ranking, traffic, project-authenticity or credential verification. Tiling.ca copy does not reproduce their guarantees or project claims.

findings.observedPattern: Floor-specific feature list and process section answer what is included and what happens next.
findings.limitation: Their generic stage labels informed information architecture only. Heating details are framed as system-specific planning; no adoption of competitor timeframes or performance claims.

findings.observedPattern: Names design choices and offers adjacent service navigation and a visible enquiry route.
findings.limitation: Countertop work is a competitor offering and is not added to Tiling.ca. Copy focuses on existing backsplash service and clear adjacent-trade boundaries.

findings.observedPattern: A dedicated panel page addresses handling, material format and related services rather than treating panels as an ordinary floor finish.
findings.limitation: No competitor maximum panel dimensions, equipment ownership, credentials or guaranteed outcomes transferred to Tiling.ca.

findings.observedPattern: Material categories, a clear assessment-to-handover sequence and links to selection/cost guidance help users compare the work.
findings.limitation: Content architecture is useful; public content does not prove ranking causation. Brand-specific benefits, warranties and site-inspection promises are not adopted.

findings.observedPattern: Manufacturer distinguishes tile/grout finish from the waterproofing assembly.
findings.limitation: Supports general scope explanation only. No statement that Tiling.ca installs this brand or follows one universal assembly.

findings.observedPattern: Official heating handbook specifies product-dependent layout restrictions and test documentation, and recommends photographing the layout for future work.
findings.limitation: No numeric layout rule, electrical procedure or brand-installation claim reused. Customer copy asks for the chosen system’s instructions and responsibilities.

findings.observedPattern: Explains substrate and levelling decisions before ordering, customer-supplied versus contractor-supplied tile, staged preparation and clearly identified setting materials. Includes task-specific FAQs and project examples.
findings.limitation: Reviewed 2026-11-08 through search-index retrieval and the existing same-session capture after direct web fetch cache misses. Adopted decision structure only; no copying of fixed prices, free measures, included removal, stock promises, warranties or project evidence. No rank causation established.

findings.observedPattern: Uses in-page navigation and an assessment-to-material-selection-to-installation sequence, with a visible service scope and customer questions. This exposes decisions that a short feature list leaves unresolved.
findings.limitation: Reviewed 2026-11-08. Tiling.ca copy uses its existing service scope and does not adopt Zelta certifications, financing, showroom, guarantees or specialist staircase-construction services. No measured ranking claim.

findings.observedPattern: Separates assessment, cleaning stages and after-care, explains when sealing is an additional decision, and distinguishes removable residue from lasting surface damage.
findings.limitation: Reviewed 2026-11-08 as supplemental specialist research. Added treatment decisions and realistic result expectations only; no equipment, pressure, chemical safety, health, restoration-service or outcome claims imported.

findings.observedPattern: The first-party service overview connects sourcing, deliveries, installation and finishing responsibility, and names commercial sectors. This makes the service boundary and logistics easier to understand.
findings.limitation: Reviewed 2026-11-08 by a direct read of the public first-party page after the web reader failed. This establishes visible content patterns, not ranking causation or Tiling.ca credentials, sectors beyond its offering, or delivery guarantees.

findings.observedPattern: The service page separates outdoor applications, materials, installation stages and related articles. Tiling.ca can answer comparable planning questions while keeping bonded tile distinct from a raised rooftop assembly.
findings.limitation: Reviewed 2026-11-08. Competitor performance, code, lifetime, brand, warranty and numerical installation assertions were not adopted. Driveway paving, excavation and snow-melt were not added as Tiling.ca services.

findings.observedPattern: The home page describes assessment, itemized scope, preparation, installation, final review and care as a sequence, alongside commercial applications. This suggests making project decisions and trade responsibilities visible on each service page.
findings.limitation: Reviewed 2026-11-08. Only the customer-information pattern informed original copy. Tiling.ca does not inherit competitor certifications, staff counts, fixed schedules, warranty terms or installation methods. Pool and fireplace scopes come from Tiling.ca’s existing verified offerings; no competitor ranking attribution.

topics: Relevant materials, services and pricing links
limits: No new services, certifications, warranties, customer reviews or completed projects inferred from competitor pages.
No promised installation or curing time; confirm selected products and site conditions.
Local service pages link the detailed guide; localized planning and price context are preserved.
